<h1 class="gb-headline gb-headline-54648d45 gb-headline-text">How to Add Social Links to DexScreener (and Improve Your token Info)</h1>



<p>The more information you share about your project, the better it looks to <strong>every investor browsing tools like DexScreener</strong>. That’s exactly why knowing how to add social links to DexScreener matters.</p>



<p>If you’re creating a token on Solana and want to add social links on DexScreener, <strong>you can do it right during the creation process</strong>, as shown below.</p>



<p>There are also other ways to change or update your token metadata on DexScreener, and we’ll cover those too. Read through to the end.</p>



<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-1dc9eda1 gb-headline-text">How to Add Social Links to DexScreener: Full Guide</h2>



<p><strong>DexScreener uses official channels to verify that the information you submit in the form is accurate</strong>. So make sure your social media links are already included in your token metadata.</p>



<p>The ideal moment to add them is during creation. The process will vary depending on whether your token is on Solana or on Ethereum (including Layer 2).</p>



<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-c16b81fc gb-headline-text">Adding Social Links to a Solana token on DexScreener</h3>



<p>If you haven’t yet <a href="https://smithii.io/en/create-solana-token" data-type="link" data-id="https://smithii.io/en/create-solana-token" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">created your token on Solana</a>, just head to <a href="https://tools.smithii.io/token-creator/solana" data-type="link" data-id="https://tools.smithii.io/token-creator/solana" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">our tool</a> and <strong>enter your social media details</strong> before creating the token. Once there, click “Add Social Links & Tags” to expand the URL fields and paste in your links. Like this:</p>



<figure class="gb-block-image gb-block-image-929695da"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1920" height="1080" class="gb-image gb-image-929695da" src="https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii.webp" alt="How to add social links on Dexscreener using Smithii: during token creation, use the token creator tool and enable &quot;Add Social Links &amp; Tags&quot; to see all available social link fields" title="how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii" srcset="https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii.webp 1920w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii-300x169.webp 300w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii-1024x576.webp 1024w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii-768x432.webp 768w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/how-to-add-social-links-dexscreener-with-smithii-1536x864.webp 1536w" sizes="(max-width: 1920px) 100vw, 1920px"></figure>



<p>Once you customize your token to your liking, <strong>social links on DexScreener will be added automatically</strong> since they’ll be baked into your token metadata.</p>



<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-495d5e73 gb-headline-text">Adding Social Links to a Ethereum or Layer 2 token on DexScreener</h3>



<p>If you have a token on Ethereum, Base, or Polygon, make sure you have access to the wallet that created the token, your contract address, and an account on the relevant blockchain explorer like <a href="https://etherscan.io" data-type="link" data-id="https://etherscan.io" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow">etherscan.io</a> for Ethereum. <strong>Here’s what you need to do:</strong></p>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Exact Match Verified</strong>: Go to the block explorer, enter the contract address for your token, and complete the contract verification and publication process.</li>



<li><strong>Verify Address Ownership</strong>: In your explorer profile, verify ownership of the token by connecting the right wallet and approving the required transactions.</li>



<li><strong>Fill Out the Update Form</strong>: With both verifications complete, you can add your logo and social media links by filling out the token meta update form on each explorer. Search Google for “Token Info Submission Guidelines + your explorer” and open the result to find the form.</li>
</ol>



<p>If you need a more detailed walkthrough, check out <a href="https://smithii.io/en/add-logo-and-social-media-links-to-erc20-token/" data-type="link" data-id="https://smithii.io/add-logo-and-social-media-links-to-erc20-token/">our full guide</a>.</p>



<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-f478f29f gb-headline-text">How to Get Your Social Links to Show Up on DexScreener</h2>



<p>If you created a token using our tools, <strong>DexScreener will automatically detect your social links</strong>. Our dApp handles all the key transactions so your token shows up on DEX and screeners alike.</p>



<p>According to <a href="https://docs.dexscreener.com/token-listing" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow">DexScreener’s own documentation</a>, the information shown on their platform is pulled from token listing sites like CoinGecko. Alternatively, you can pay for the Enhanced Token Info from DexScreener, <strong>a feature that lets you add exclusive information</strong> and stand out from the thousands of other tokens on the platform.</p>



<p>That said, this option requires <strong>a payment of $299 USD</strong>, as shown in the image below:</p>



<figure class="gb-block-image gb-block-image-a9d26df6"><img decoding="async" width="1920" height="1080" class="gb-image gb-image-a9d26df6" src="https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot.webp" alt="Add metadata to your token on Dexscreener with the Enhanced Token Info feature (costs $299 USD) to boost your token's visibility on the platform." title="enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot" srcset="https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot.webp 1920w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot-300x169.webp 300w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot-1024x576.webp 1024w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot-768x432.webp 768w, https://smithii.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/enhanced-token-info-dexscreener-feature-screenshot-1536x864.webp 1536w" sizes="(max-width: 1920px) 100vw, 1920px"></figure>



<p>If you want to <strong>update your token metadata on DexScreener</strong> (and your token isn’t an <a href="https://smithii.io/en/token-inmutable-solana/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">immutable token</a> yet), you have two options:</p>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li>Use our <a href="https://tools.smithii.io/update-token/solana" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">metadata update tool</a>.</li>



<li>Update it manually through listing platforms (tedious and time-consuming).</li>
</ol>



<p>Either way, <strong>you’ll need access to the wallet that created the token</strong> and must verify the token. For a full <a href="https://smithii.io/en/update-token-metadata-solana/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">step-by-step guide to updating social links on DexScreener</a>, check out the dedicated guide on our blog.</p>



<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-d5d2d73b gb-headline-text">How to Fill Out the DEX Screener Form for Enhanced Token Info</h3>



<p>To improve your token’s visibility and information on DEX Screener, you’ll need to fill out a specific form in their marketplace. Below is a breakdown of each section and how to complete it:</p>



<h4 class="gb-headline gb-headline-e9777fbe gb-headline-text">Token Information:</h4>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Chain Selection</strong>:<br>Choose the blockchain your token is deployed on, such as Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, and others.</li>



<li><strong>Token Address (Token Address)</strong>:<br>Enter the contract address of the token you want to update. Make sure it’s correct, as this links the metadata you submit directly to that token.</li>



<li><strong>Project Description (Project Description)</strong>:<br>Write a clear, concise description of the project behind the token. Plain text only, but emojis and line breaks are supported. This description will appear on the pair detail page for your token.</li>



<li><strong>Links (Links)</strong>:<br>You can add multiple links related to your project:</li>
</ol>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Website</strong>: Add the official project website.</li>



<li><strong>Documentation</strong>: Link to the project’s official docs, such as the whitepaper.</li>



<li><strong>Social Media</strong>: Add links to X (Twitter), Telegram, Discord, and more.</li>



<li><strong>Additional Links</strong>: Any other relevant links that don’t fit the categories above, such as profiles on other platforms.</li>
</ul>



<h4 class="gb-headline gb-headline-ee24806d gb-headline-text">Images:</h4>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Token Icon (Token Icon)</strong>: Upload a square image (1:1 aspect ratio), at least 100px wide. High resolution is recommended; DEX Screener handles compression on its end.</li>



<li><strong>Token Header or Banner (Token Header)</strong>: Upload a rectangular image (3:1 aspect ratio), at least 600px wide. This appears on the token pair page. Your X (Twitter) profile banner works well here.</li>
</ul>



<h4 class="gb-headline gb-headline-1ff060bf gb-headline-text">Other Options:</h4>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Locked Supply (Locked Supply)</strong> <em>(Optional)</em>:<br>If your token has addresses holding locked tokens, list them here along with a brief explanation of why and how the supply was locked. Standard burn addresses don’t need to be included; DEX Screener checks those automatically.</li>



<li><strong>Contact Info (Contact Info)</strong> <em>(Optional)</em>:<br>Add your Discord or Telegram handle if you want DEX Screener to reach you quickly with any questions or clarifications. This can speed up the approval process.</li>
</ol>



<p>The service costs $299, with an average processing time of under 15 minutes after payment.</p>



<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-1884ef10 gb-headline-text">FAQ: Metadata on DexScreener</h2>



<p>There are a few questions we didn’t want to leave out of this post, ones <strong>our community keeps asking</strong>. This section covers the most common ones. (Got another question? Drop it and we’ll answer it.)</p>



<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-c151ab5d gb-headline-text">What size should the DexScreener Banner be?</h3>



<p>If you’ve paid for the Enhanced Token Info feature, you can upload a banner that shows in your token’s info section. The banner <strong>must have a 3:1 aspect ratio with at least 100px on each side</strong>, but we recommend 600px wide by 200px tall.</p>



<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-ac697d8f gb-headline-text">Why can’t I update my social links on DexScreener?</h3>



<p>You can email DexScreener directly to have your metadata updated after changing your token. <strong>Keep in mind you’ll need access to the wallet that created the token</strong> to update its metadata and confirm that the token is mutable.</p>



<h3 class="gb-headline gb-headline-90a72d39 gb-headline-text">How do I add social links to my token on DexScreener?</h3>



<p>If you haven’t created your token yet, use the <a href="https://tools.smithii.io/token-creator/solana" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Solana Token Creator</a> by Smithii to include social links, and <strong>DexScreener will add them automatically</strong>. If your token is already live and you forgot to add links, use our metadata update tool or verify you’re the creator on the blockchain scanner and request a metadata update.</p>



<h2 class="gb-headline gb-headline-d05b5ae1 gb-headline-text">Conclusion</h2>



<p>Now you know how to add social links on DexScreener, a key step that makes your token stand out from the rest of the listed tokens. Keep in mind that <strong>they’re a core part of your marketing strategy</strong> and help build trust with anyone who finds your project through the platform.</p>



<p>What are you waiting for? Add your project’s social links on DexScreener now. <strong>Don’t miss out on the visibility boost</strong>.</p>
